description: This file defines the CacheBackendInterface interface for cache implementations in Drupal, including method signatures for cache operations such as get, set, delete, invalidate, and garbage collection.

classes.name: CacheBackendInterface
classes.description: Interface for cache backend implementations in Drupal, specifying methods for cache management.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieve a cache item by its cache ID, with optional validity override.

methods.name: getMultiple
methods.description: Retrieve multiple cache items given an array of cache IDs.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Store data in the cache with a specified expiration and tags.

methods.name: setMultiple
methods.description: Store multiple cache items at once.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Delete a cache item by its cache ID.

methods.name: deleteAll
methods.description: Delete all cache items in a bin.

methods.name: invalidate
methods.description: Mark a cache item as invalid.

methods.name: invalidateMultiple
methods.description: Mark multiple cache items as invalid.

methods.name: invalidateAll
methods.description: Mark all cache items as invalid (deprecated).

methods.name: garbageCollection
methods.description: Perform garbage collection on cache items.
